#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""
Digital Pet for Linux
A simple desktop pet that needs food and water
"""

import tkinter as tk
import json
import os
import threading
import time
from datetime import datetime, timedelta

class DigitalPet:
    def __init__(self):
        self.root = tk.Tk()
        self.root.title("Digital Pet")
        self.root.geometry("300x400")
        self.root.attributes("-topmost", True)  # Stay on top
        self.root.resizable(False, False)

        # Pet state
        self.hunger = 50
        self.thirst = 50
        self.happiness = 100
        self.last_save = datetime.now()

        # Load saved state if exists
        self.load_state()

        # GUI elements
        self.setup_gui()

        # Start timers
        self.start_timers()

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""
Digital Pet for Linux - KDE Breeze Theme
A simple desktop pet that needs food and water
"""

import tkinter as tk
import json
import os
import threading
import time
from datetime import datetime, timedelta

class DigitalPet:
    def __init__(self):
        self.root = tk.Tk()
        self.root.title("Digital Pet")
        self.root.geometry("320x450")
        self.root.attributes("-topmost", True)  # Stay on top
        self.root.resizable(False, False)

        # KDE Breeze color scheme
        self.colors = {
            'bg': '#eff0f1',           # Breeze background
            'window_bg': '#fcfcfc',    # Window background
            'text': '#232629',         # Text color
            'button_bg': '#3daee9',    # Button background
            'button_hover': '#93cee9', # Button hover
            'button_text': '#ffffff',  # Button text
            'progress_bg': '#bdc3c7',  # Progress bar background
            'progress_fg': '#27ae60',  # Progress bar foreground
            'pet_happy': '#f39c12',    # Happy pet color
            'pet_okay': '#e67e22',     # Okay pet color
            'pet_sad': '#e74c3c'       # Sad pet color
        }

        # Set window background
        self.root.configure(bg=self.colors['window_bg'])

        # Pet state
        self.hunger = 50
        self.thirst = 50
        self.happiness = 100
        self.last_save = datetime.now()

        # Load saved state if exists
        self.load_state()

        # GUI elements
        self.setup_gui()

        # Start timers
        self.start_timers()
